content.short: Kuru is a high-performance on-chain Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) DEX built on Monad.
content.description: Kuru is a revolutionary decentralized exchange built on the ultra-fast Monad blockchain, offering a fully on-chain Central Limit Order Book (CLOB). Unlike traditional AMMs, Kuru provides traders with an institutional-grade experience featuring sub-second execution, transparent price discovery, and deep liquidity for spot assets. By leveraging Monad's parallel execution capabilities, Kuru eliminates the trade-offs between decentralization and performance, making high-frequency trading and complex order types accessible to everyone on-chain.
